title: Define the clause-naming and reference rules
acceptance: Specifies the reference grammar PREFIX-file:rule, ordinal numbering and how a document declares its prefix.
Contains a prefix registry listing every existing prefix (SSOT, ATA, CNS, CTR, PMT, RTM) and the prefixes chosen in D-01 for every other framework area, each used by exactly one area.
States immutability: IDs are never reassigned; withdrawn rules keep their ID and are marked RETIRED, with the marking convention.
Defines ID families for open items (PREFIX-O-nn, CORE-O-nn), default values (DV-PREFIX-nn) and obligations (by reference to the obligation-id-scheme).
Includes at least three worked examples (new clause, retired clause, cross-reference) in plain text.
